prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic glamorous luxury mirror selfie of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness exactly, with no celebrity or public-figure substitution. She has medium-dark skin, long straight shiny black center-parted hair, dramatic winged eyeliner, long lashes, contoured natural makeup, glossy lips, and a confident composed expression. She sits with crossed legs in an armchair and holds a phone for a centered full-body mirror selfie. She wears a black fitted crop top, shiny black leather leggings, a bold gold Cuban-link chain, large gold hoops, rings, and bracelets. Set the scene in a luxury hotel suite with a large ornate gold mirror, soft golden window light, and warm elegant room ambience. Keep controlled highlights on jewelry and leather, natural skin texture, and a glamorous high-fashion atmosphere. No logos, watermark, or readable text.
